verdict.rationale: Reducto documents AI-driven document processing: LLM-based field extraction, natural-language classification and splitting, and agentic parsing with custom prompts. Studio is a workflow builder with a citation viewer. Nothing in the pack shows the product generating insights, analysis or suggestions from a user's data; extraction and classification are adjacent capabilities, not in-product insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
